messages:
alex_sales: hey folks — Peregrine Bank sent a SIG. They want itemized evidence (question-by-question) for encryption, network segmentation, IAM, SOC2/pen test, and private deploy checklist. Can someone own assembly? deadline EOD Wed.
meera_ps: I can own the assembly. Which exact artifacts do we need to map to each SIG question?
alex_sales: list from the buyer:
  1) Encryption at rest: KMS certificate, key rotation policy, algorithms used
  2) Network segmentation: VPC/network diagram + firewall rules summary
  3) IAM: RBAC matrix, SSO screenshots, SCIM provisioning proof
  4) Compliance: SOC2 report (redacted if necessary) + latest pen test summary + remediation tracker
  5) Private deployment: on-prem install checklist + network isolation steps
  6) Log retention and access logs proof
  Please include filenames and a short description mapping to SIG Q IDs. @meera_ps pls coordinate.
tom_security: I can pull KMS rotation policy and SOC2 artifacts. KMS policy lives in the security wiki: /internal/security/kms-rotation.md — I will export the signed attestation PDF. Pen test report is full but sensitive; we usually provide a redacted summary + remediation CSV.
devon_cse: I have VPC diagrams and the private deploy checklist. Also can grab firewall config snippets and an architecture diagram (SVG + PDF). SCIM screenshots are in the admin console; I'll take a couple masked screenshots showing provisioning flow.
meera_ps: perfect — I'll create an evidence_map.csv that maps SIG question IDs -> artifact filenames -> brief note. Quick question on rotation cadence: do we state CMK rotates annually or DEKs more frequently?
tom_security: be exact: CMKs rotated annually in our KMS; DEKs (data encryption keys) rotated by default every 90 days per runtime agent. Algorithms: AES-256-GCM for DEKs, RSA-2048 used for wrapping where applicable. Paste this snippet into the mapping: ```RotationPolicy: { CMK: "annual", DEK: "90d", Algorithms: ["AES-256-GCM","RSA-2048"] }```
alex_sales: :thumbsup: include that exact snippet. Also buyer asked for proof of KMS key rotation — include the key metadata export (timestamped) and a short log extract showing a rotation event.
audit_bot: Created secure share: https://files.redwood.internal/peregrine-sig-1961234567 (expires 14d). Please upload there.
meera_ps: uploading initial package to the share now: evidence_map.csv, kms_rotation_attestation.pdf, soc2_redacted_v2.pdf, pen_test_summary.csv, vpc_diagram.pdf, onprem_checklist.md, scim_screenshots.zip. @tom_security pls review redactions on pen_test_summary and SOC2 before I hand off.
tom_security: will review in ~30m. note: full SOC2 requires NDA/MSA addendum before we provide the unredacted version; recommend we send redacted now and request the addendum via AE.
alex_sales: I'll ask AE to get the addendum started. After tom signs off, meera, send the zip and update the deal tracker with "SIG evidence sent" and timestamp.
meera_ps: understood — will wait for tom, then send. will also include a one-line mapping per SIG question for quick reviewer scan.
alex_sales: thanks team — this should close the last security blocker for the deal. :raised_hands:
